description: Create a USDC escrow with built-in dispute resolution. Funds are locked on-chain until delivery is confirmed (release) or a problem is flagged (dispute). If disputed, an arbiter reviews and rules — the only escrow service with real dispute resolution on Base.

seller.description: Ethereum address of the seller/service provider

service_url.description: URL or identifier of the service being purchased (used for tracking)

timelock_minutes.description: Minutes until escrow expires and auto-refunds (default: 30)

name: escrow_create
